subject: general
question: Which of the following states shares borders with three different countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** is a northeastern state of **India** located in the **Eastern Himalayas**.
 
• It shares international borders with **three different countries**:
 
 
• **Nepal** in the west
 
• **Bhutan** in the east
 
• **China (Tibet Autonomous Region)** in the north and northeast
 
 
 
• Because of its strategic location, Sikkim is considered very important for the **security and defense** of India.
 
• The state became a part of India in the year **1975** as the **22nd state** of the Indian Union.
 
• **Gangtok** is the capital city of Sikkim.
 
• Sikkim is the **least populous state** in India and is known for its rich biodiversity and mountainous terrain.
 
• **Kanchenjunga**, the **highest mountain peak in India** and the third-highest in the world, is located in Sikkim.
 
• Sikkim is also famous for being India’s first fully **organic farming state**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir**__

 __
 
• **Jammu & Kashmir** shares borders with **Pakistan** and **China**.
 
• After the **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation Act, 2019**, it became a **Union Territory**.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** shares an international border only with **China**.
 
• It is known for hill stations such as **Shimla**, **Manali**, and **Dharamshala**.
 
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh**__
 
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** shares an international border only with **Nepal**.
 
• It is the **most populous state** in India.
